name: tourwerk
description: Tourwerk – last-mile delivery dispatch, route optimization and live fleet tracking

scripts.dev: npm run native && npm run services && npm -w apps/api run db:deploy && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm -w apps/api run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm run native && npm -w apps/api run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: make -s -C native test && npm run services && npm -w apps/api test && npm -w apps/web test
scripts.e2e: npm run native && npm run services && npm -w e2e test
